comment: Default policy and hard bounds for colony-owned search and healing knobs. Bounds in colony/self_heal.py are authoritative; this file cannot widen them, touch the Oracle, the P >= 0.70 gate, the 150 authored-check cap, Athanor math, human authorize, or the witness log. Runtime adopted values live in society/systems/self_heal.json and are not this file.

park_cycles.doc: Cycles a repeated proposal stays parked.

block_streak_to_park.doc: Consecutive repeat-blocks before a proposal is parked.

stall_cycles.doc: Flat Oracle-pass cycles before STALL fires.

perturb_max_cycles.doc: PERTURB exits after this many cycles if nothing new is found.

perturb_wide_epsilon.doc: Wider exploration rate after a PERTURB timeout. Must be >= perturb_epsilon.

perturb_min_targets.doc: Minimum distinct targets a PERTURB turn should draw.

perturb_cooldown_cycles.doc: Cycles to wait after a no-progress PERTURB timeout before re-entry.

perturb_zero_pick_cycles.doc: Consecutive 0-pick PERTURB cycles (after mutation-first escalation) before exiting to the no-progress cooldown with a no_candidates lesson.

unused_menu_cycles.doc: How far back PERTURB looks to treat a target as already tried.

family_rotation_penalty.doc: Score multiplier for the claim form just attempted (lower means stronger rotation).

quarantine_cycles.doc: Cycles a failing optional step stays quarantined.

quarantine_fail_threshold.doc: Failures of one step before it is quarantined.

step_size.doc: Fraction of a knob's range used as one adjustment step. Tunable by the same evidence rule.

evaluation_window.doc: Cycles of trial vs baseline compared before adopt or revert. Tunable by the same evidence rule.

gf_term_cap.doc: Slow series-arithmetic term cap (algebraic / EGF / fallback g.f.).

deep_term_cap.doc: Term cap for non-C-finite deep search (relations, properties).

fast_term_cap.doc: Term cap used when a C-finite exact iterator applies.

deep_digits.doc: Decimal-digit budget for exact integer terms.

deep_seconds.doc: Time budget in seconds for one evaluator call. Kept inside CI limits.
